source: Sequence and details from timelinev1.netlify.app (islamic_timeline_data.js), oldest first. Dates are the site's estimates; most are speculative in Islamic tradition.

nodes.title: The Heavens and the Earth
nodes.summary: The earth is created.

nodes.title: The Jinn
nodes.summary: The jinn are created from fire. Among them is Iblis, counted in tradition among the most devout of them before his fall.

nodes.title: Adam and Hawwa
nodes.summary: The creation of the first humans according to Islamic belief: the khalifah, the Garden, the whisper, repentance and the descent to earth.

nodes.title: The Beginning of Humanity
nodes.summary: Adam's family on earth: the first home, Habil and Qabil, the first murder, the crow, and guidance passed to Shith.

nodes.title: Prophet Idris
nodes.summary: Shith carries Adam's guidance and humanity spreads; Idris, a man of truth, writes with the pen, calls his people with patience and is raised to a high station; after him the people raise statues to five righteous men.

nodes.title: Prophet Nuh and the Great Flood
nodes.summary: Nuh calls his people openly and in secret for nine hundred and fifty years, and only a few believe. He builds the ark on dry land, the believers and the animals board, the flood rises and recedes, and they descend in peace onto the washed earth.

nodes.title: Prophet Hud
nodes.summary: A prophet sent to the people of ʿAd.

nodes.title: Prophet Salih
nodes.summary: A prophet sent to the people of Thamud.

nodes.title: Prophet Ibrahim
nodes.summary: A major prophet in Islam, remembered as the father of monotheism.

nodes.title: Prophet Lut
nodes.summary: A prophet sent to the people of Sodom and Gomorrah.

nodes.title: Prophet Ismail
nodes.summary: Son of Ibrahim, associated with the building of the Kaaba.

nodes.title: Prophet Ishaq
nodes.summary: Son of Ibrahim, father of Yaqub.

nodes.title: Prophet Yaqub
nodes.summary: Son of Ishaq, also known as Israel.

nodes.title: Prophet Yusuf
nodes.summary: Son of Yaqub, known for his story of patience and forgiveness.

nodes.title: Prophet Ayyub
nodes.summary: Known for his patience in the face of suffering.

nodes.title: Prophet Shuʿayb
nodes.summary: Sent to the people of Madyan.

nodes.title: Prophet Musa
nodes.summary: Received the Torah and led the Children of Israel out of Egypt.

nodes.title: Prophet Harun
nodes.summary: Brother of Musa and his helper in prophethood.

nodes.title: Prophet Dhul-Kifl
nodes.summary: Mentioned in the Quran; his identity is debated among scholars.

nodes.title: Prophet Dawud
nodes.summary: King and prophet, given the Zabur (Psalms).

nodes.title: Prophet Sulayman
nodes.summary: Son of Dawud, known for his wisdom and power.

nodes.title: Prophet Ilyas
nodes.summary: Sent to the Children of Israel.

nodes.title: Prophet Al-Yasaʿ
nodes.summary: Successor to Prophet Ilyas.

nodes.title: Prophet Yunus
nodes.summary: Known for his story with the whale.

nodes.title: Prophet Zakariya
nodes.summary: Father of Yahya and guardian of Maryam.

nodes.title: Prophet Yahya
nodes.summary: Son of Zakariya, a contemporary of Isa.

nodes.title: Prophet Isa
nodes.summary: Born to Maryam and given the Injil (Gospel).

nodes.title: Stories of Wisdom
nodes.summary: The People of the Cave, Dhul-Qarnayn, the two gardens, the man who slept a hundred years, and Luqman's advice.

nodes.title: Birth of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ
nodes.summary: The final messenger is born in Mecca.

nodes.title: The First Revelation
nodes.summary: Prophet Muhammad ﷺ receives the first revelation of the Quran in the Cave of Hira.

nodes.title: Death of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ
nodes.summary: The Prophet ﷺ passes away in Medina, marking the end of prophethood.

nodes.title: The Minor Signs
nodes.summary: Qiyamah (end times): the signs that come before the Hour.

nodes.title: The Major Signs
nodes.summary: The great signs that come just before the Hour.

nodes.title: The Day of Judgment
nodes.summary: The Day when every soul is shown what it carried of the Trust.
